items.title: Venezuela quake survivor pulled out alive after eight days
items.description: Hernán Gil was trapped under a collapsed multi-storey car park, and encouraged them as they inched closer to him.

items.title: 'Most massive' Russian attack on Kyiv kills at least 27
items.description: The latest barrage deployed the largest number of weapons on the capital and hit locations over a wide area.

items.title: Bomb blast at Damascus cafe kills six, Syrian state media say
items.description: There was no immediate claim for the bombing at a cafe close to the Palace of Justice, a major government building.

items.title: Vatican excommunicates followers of global Catholic sect
items.description: Around 600,000 followers of the Society of Saint Pius X, a Catholic sect, are affected.

items.title: China says pilot crashed small plane into skyscraper for 'personal reasons'
items.description: The 66-year-old, who died in the crash, had anxiety and referenced "ending his life" in his diary.

items.title: Former Olympian indicted for allegedly vandalising Washington Reflecting Pool
items.description: US authorities charged him with property destruction after renovations championed by President Donald Trump appeared to go awry.

items.title: South Africa and Ghana in diplomatic row over alleged killing of migrant
items.description: South Africa denies claims that a Ghanaian citizen was killed in anti-migrant protests in Cape Town.

items.title: Ebola treatments trial begins in the Democratic Republic of Congo
items.description: According to WHO data, there have been 1,406 confirmed cases of the disease in DRC, with 301 suspected cases and 438 deaths.

items.title: Killers of British couple in South Africa sentenced to life
items.description: The pair had been collecting rare plants and seeds before their bodies were found days later in a river.

items.title: Canadian boy, 11, dies of rabies after waking to bat on his face
items.description: Rabies infections are rare in Canada. There have been 28 human deaths due to rabies in the country since 1924.

items.title: People smuggler convicted in France found by BBC living in UK and seeking asylum
items.description: Once described as "the godfather" of French migrant camps, he has been working in a Leicestershire village.

items.title: Nine Thai monks killed after 11-year-old driver collides with procession
items.description: The group of 35 monks and five lay followers were walking by the roadside when the truck ploughed into them.
